review.headline: A sharp kingside-versus-queenside race decided on the clock

sections.text: Out of a Pirc Defense, you developed cleanly and gained the bishop pair. After Black castled queenside, you immediately targeted their king with 13.Be3! and a queenside pawn storm.

Black cracked open the center with 14...d5?, allowing 15.exd5!. You pushed forward with 16.a5?? instead of taking on d5 with 16.Bxd5 cxd5 17.Bxa7+ Ka8 18.Nb5 Qc6, but Black returned the favor with 16...Nxc3??. You then played 19.Reb1??, setting up a pin on the b6-pawn against the king, before Black flagged.

review.turning_point: Black's mistimed 14...d5? blew open lines toward their own king, handing you a decisive initiative.
